repositories.name: Bytebase (Database DevOps & GitOps)
repositories.primary_metric: Web-based database DevOps portal with GitOps schema change review, SQL linting, and RBAC across 15+ databases
repositories.production_tradeoff: Requires dedicated Go/Next.js container deployment and metadata database (Postgres/MySQL)

repositories.name: Atlas (Declarative Schema Migration)
repositories.primary_metric: Modern declarative schema management engine computing automatic DDL diffs from HCL or SQL schemas with CI drift detection
repositories.production_tradeoff: Cloud schema registry features (Atlas Cloud) require subscription or self-hosted CLI workflows

repositories.name: golang-migrate (CLI & Go Library)
repositories.primary_metric: Zero-dependency Go CLI and library executing forward/backward migration pairs across 20+ SQL/NoSQL drivers
repositories.production_tradeoff: Imperative numbered migration files without automated schema drift or conflict resolution

repositories.name: Flyway Community Edition
repositories.primary_metric: Canonical version control for relational databases executing SQL-based migrations with transactional checksums
repositories.production_tradeoff: Advanced features (dry-run, undo, drift check) locked behind Redgate commercial licenses

repositories.name: Liquibase Community
repositories.primary_metric: Enterprise database change management supporting XML, YAML, JSON, and formatted SQL changelogs
repositories.production_tradeoff: JVM runtime overhead and verbose XML changelog syntax compared to lightweight Go binaries
